tables.title: Paving Blocks

tables.label: Machinery Hire
tables.title: Machinery Hire
tables.description: Site equipment for hire by the day or by the hour, up to 6 hours a day.
rules: Hourly hire is limited to 6 hours a day. Beyond 6 hours, the full daily rate applies.
Overtime beyond 6 hours is charged at UGX 25,000 per hour, up to 8 hours.
All hire is subject to availability, and additional terms and conditions may apply.

notes: Paver codes P1, P2 … are our standard pavers.
Custom design codes C1, C2 … are custom pavers that can be made in specific sizes on request.
Prices may vary based on material, finish or bulk orders.
Delivery fees may apply depending on location and order size.
